title: Eleonora Probable NDE 3054
content: I was sleeping and dreaming. Suddenly my dream interrupted and I was in a tunnel with a light in the bottom. I began to move fast in the tunnel toward the light. In the light I founded all the persons that I have known in my several past existences, I saw this like an old photo group, all the persons were happy to see me. I was watching the persons and suddenly to my left I was approached by a middle aged man with a beard that asked me, in authoritarian tone, why I were here. I answered that I didn't know why I were here. He said to me that it was not my moment and I had to go back. I answered that I didn't want to go back, I was happy in that moment and I wanted to stay here. He accompanied me far away from the group and then my short life passed in front of me. I felt all the pain I caused to my parents with my whims as a child. Then the man said to me that I must return because persons needed me. In that moment, I saw my future (unfortunately, I forgot this part) and I understood that it was right for me to go back. Suddenly I was over my body. I began to return in my body from the feet and I felt the heat go up from my feet towards my head. I was able to move only when I completed this return to my body. In that moment I was thinking that it was only a strange dream and I continued sleeping.

arrival.other_being_detail: A middle-aged bearded man speaking in an authoritarian tone; also 'all the persons that I have known in my several past existences' seen like an 'old photo group'.

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Told it was not her moment; also that 'persons needed me'.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: The man said she must return because 'persons needed me'.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Future glimpse was mentioned but forgotten by the experiencer.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel and light first; encounter with group and a bearded man; life review; future glimpse; then above-body perception and gradual re-entry into body from feet upward.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Experience began during sleep/dreaming; group described as persons known from 'several past existences' seen like an 'old photo group'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Suddenly my dream interrupted and I was in a tunnel with a light in the bottom.” “He said to me that it was not my moment and I had to go back.” “Then my short life passed in front of me.” “I began to return in my body from the feet and I felt the heat go up from my feet towards my head.”
